[**![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1070751/description_7acdccbe-8e6f-49f6-bde2-ee820d4370a9.png)**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nether-descent)

** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1070751/description_10da38ee-7e1c-4d1d-9bf5-d07267b232ad.png)** **《Oh The Biomes We've Gone》是經典模組《Oh The Biomes You'll Go》的續作，適用於 1.20.1+ 版本，包含超過 50 個令人驚嘆的奇幻與寫實生態域。BWG 將透過為 Minecraft 注入多樣且細緻的生機，帶你展開一場冒險旅程。BWG 還新增了獨特的生物、結構與數百種可供使用的方塊。** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_43d7961e-7fe6-4cab-9073-f96e1a05c5bf.png)**
